windows.prospect_watch: every day 08:00-22:00 Istanbul, every 15 minutes (v11_prospect_watch.in_window, config window; a run that starts up to 5 minutes after 22:00 still works; the client chain hours are unchanged)

cloud_run_jobs.name: hamle-prospect-watch
cloud_run_jobs.image: <image built from publish HEAD via package_chain_source.py>
cloud_run_jobs.gcloud: gcloud run jobs create hamle-prospect-watch --project=gamechangers-hamle --region=europe-west1 --image=<IMAGE> --service-account=hamle-runtime@gamechangers-hamle.iam.gserviceaccount.com --set-env-vars=<same HAMLE_* env as hamle-account-manager> --command=python --args=worker.py,--mode,prospect_watch --tasks=1 --parallelism=1 --max-retries=0 --task-timeout=840s
cloud_run_jobs.why_separate_job: scheduler calls :run without overrides; one job per mode keeps default args explicit

iam.scheduler_invoker: roles/run.invoker for hamle-scheduler@ on hamle-prospect-watch (same condition as the other jobs)

apply_sequence: rebuild the image with package_chain_source.py (adds v11_prospect_watch.py, the four prospect prompts and chain-profile/prospect-watch-config.json)
create the hamle-prospect-watch job; describe and compare
grant invoker IAM for hamle-scheduler@ on the new job
create both scheduler jobs with inert schedule '0 0 1 1 *', pause, patch the final schedule, describe PAUSED
Basecamp: lists 'Hamle Yeni Temaslar' and 'Hamle Araştırma İstekleri' exist in project 40704547 and are hidden from clients
import the owner's known-people list (python3 v11_prospect_watch.py people import ...), optional
set enabled=true in prospect-watch-config.json, rebuild, and resume only after the owner's word
gcloud_scheduler_reference: gcloud scheduler jobs update http <name> --project=gamechangers-hamle --location=europe-west1 --schedule='<final schedule>'
gcloud scheduler jobs describe <name> --project=gamechangers-hamle --location=europe-west1  (require state PAUSED + exact config)
gcloud scheduler jobs resume <name> --project=gamechangers-hamle --location=europe-west1  (activation; costs money per run)
cost: 57 billed Cloud Run executions a day; an empty run makes 0 model calls; per new prospect mail about 0.15-0.25 USD (Haiku classification + one Opus research call with at most 2 searches + one Opus reply); an owner-approved research report about 0.5-1.5 USD
stop: gcloud scheduler jobs pause hamle-prospect-watch-day hamle-prospect-watch-close --location=europe-west1
